title: List fold loop
summary: Proves that the compiler's list fold statement leaves the fold of a List UInt64 in the accumulator local, for a UInt64 or Float accumulator, from one obligation about the fold body's expression.
premises: Four distinct fold locals below the scratch index
ListAt for the list in the initial memory, which NodeBorrowed.listAt gives for a borrowed argument
The body evaluates to g a e whenever the accumulator holds accType.value a and the element local holds .i64 e
result: A Triple whose postcondition keeps the store, frames every other local below scratch, and puts accType.value (xs.foldl g start) in the accumulator.
